description: Texas Rangers placed RHP Nathan Eovaldi on the 15-day injured list retroactive to May 29, 2025. Right posterior elbow inflammation.
Detroit Tigers placed RHP Jason Foley on the 60-day injured list. Recovery from right shoulder surgery.
Toronto Blue Jays placed CF Daulton Varsho on the 10-day injured list. Left hamstring strain.
Minnesota Twins transferred RHP Chris Paddack from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list. Right forearm strain.
Houston Astros placed C Evan Gattis on the 15-day disabled list retroactive to March 25, 2015. Sports hernia
Milwaukee Brewers transferred LF Rymer Liriano from the 15-day disabled list to the 60-day disabled list. Facial fractures
Kansas City Royals placed LHP John Bale on the 15-day disabled list retroactive to March 27, 2009.
Tampa Bay Rays activated RHP Zack Littell from the 15-day injured list.
Los Angeles Angels recalled LHP Reid Detmers from Salt Lake Bees.
Minnesota Twins selected the contract of 2B Michael Helman from St. Paul Saints.
New York Yankees optioned RHP Will Warren to Scranton/Wilkes-Barre RailRiders.
Colorado Rockies sent RHP Noah Davis outright to Albuquerque Isotopes.
Toronto Blue Jays claimed RHP Dillon Tate off waivers from Baltimore Orioles.
San Diego Padres designated RHP Lake Bachar for assignment.
Washington Nationals reassigned RHP Michael Rucker to the minor leagues.
San Francisco Giants traded 2B Cavan Biggio to Atlanta Braves.
